title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Services Note — Purchase Orders, Authorized Buyers and Exemption Certificates
content:
## Who may change the settings, and when

Only an owner or principal of the business may change the purchase order requirement, the number of authorized buyers or the tax exemption on file of a Ridgeline Pro Credit account; the authority is the caller's own statement of their role for that account. Settings may be changed while the account status is active or on hold, as the account record shows.

## Limits of each setting

- **Authorized buyers.** The number of authorized buyers may never exceed the tier's maximum authorized buyers.
- **Purchase order requirement.** It may be set to required only on a tier that offers the purchase order option.
- **Exemption certificate.** A tax exemption certificate is placed on file with its number exactly as printed, and its effective date and expiry date as stated on the certificate. An expired certificate is not placed on file, and a renewal replaces the earlier certificate's dates.

Placing a certificate on file never changes invoices already posted; tax already charged is credited back only as a sales tax credit.

## Hypothetical cases

| Request | Tier | Outcome under these limits |
|---|---|---|
| Raise authorized buyers to 6 | Pro Revolving Charge (maximum 5) | Exceeds the maximum |
| Raise authorized buyers to 25 | Commercial Account Net 30 (maximum 25) | Within the maximum |
| Require a purchase order on every invoice | Pro Revolving Charge (option not offered) | Not available |
| Place a certificate that expired last month on file | Any | Not placed on file |
| A principal of a closed account asks to change buyers | Any | Status not active or on hold |
